programmes.d: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programmes.d: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.
Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

Viggo Mortensen (Green Book) spiller en undercoveragent, der er steget i graderne hos Yakuza, og nu befinder sig midt i en krig mellem Yakuza, mafiaen og FBI. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

Efter at en tidligere politibetjent (Michael Rooker, Guardians of the Galaxy) bliver indblandet i en kamp mellem japanske gangstere og bøller, opdager han, at han er blevet fældet af en korrupt politibetjent. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

Quintus er romersk centurion. Sammen med sine mænd er han fanget i fjendeland, omringet af stammefolket picterne. På hjemmebane er picterne en svær modstander, og Quintus og hans mænd må kæmpe vel vidende, at hvert øjeblik kan blive deres sidste.

Mød Englands voldeligste mand: Bedre kendt som Charles Bronson blev Michael Peterson i en alder af 19 år anholdt for væbnet røveri. Med sine talrige overgreb har han tilbragt 34 år i fængsel og har samlet set været løsladt i lidt under fire måneder.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programmes.d: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.
Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programmes.d: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programmes.d: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.
When a paramilitary faction used bombs and robbery to further their cause, they crossed the line. The well-organized terror cell was difficult to define, and even harder to stop.
